clue.text: Those in authority lead soldiers involved in project

indicators.note: the lead and soldiers are involved in, that is set inside, the word for project

parts.note: to project is to throw or toss
Pb is the chemical symbol for lead
RA is the Royal Artillery, a body of soldiers

explanation.surface: People in charge put a lead soldier at the heart of some scheme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lead' reads as a verb but is the metal, PB. PBRA goes inside TOSS, after its first two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The top brass are the senior officers or bosses of an organisation.

clue.text: Section of church, part with stone renovated, lacking nothing

indicators.note: renovated means the letters of the two words are rebuilt in a new order

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: Part of a church is being rebuilt in stone, with nothing missing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacking' says the O for 'nothing' is the letter left over: PART and STONE together, less O, rearrange to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A transept is the cross arm of a cruciform church, running across the nave.

clue.text: Make switch in colour

indicators.note: the switch is placed in the colour word, splitting it after its first letter

parts.note: puce is a purplish-brown colour
a switch is a thin stick or rod

explanation.surface: An instruction to swap one colour for another.
explanation.definitionFit: To produce something is to make or manufacture it.

clue.text: One amid rising fury disregarding a rule

indicators.note: amid places the letter for one in the middle of the other letters
disregarding means the letter A is ignored and dropped
in a down clue rising means the word for fury is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: fury is anger
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Somebody caught up in growing anger ignores a rule.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns ANGER into REGNA; 'disregarding a' drops the A to leave REGN, and 'amid' puts I in the middle.
explanation.definitionFit: To reign is to rule as monarch.

clue.text: Person who'll be dependable, chosen with heart fluttering

indicators.note: a fluttering heart is unsteady, signalling the letters are thrown about into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone you can rely on is chosen, making the heart flutter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' joins the two fodder words CHOSEN and HEART, which rearrange together.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheet anchor is a ship's spare anchor, figuratively a person or thing relied on in an emergency.

clue.text: Favour force

explanation.surface: Two words that both mean making someone do something.
explanation.definitionFit: To oblige someone is to do them a favour; to oblige is also to compel or force.

clue.text: Attempts to arrest deceiver after end of illegal game

indicators.note: to arrest is to catch and hold, so the attempts word holds the other letters inside

parts.note: attempts are bids

indicators.note: after places the deceiver following that letter
end of picks out the final letter of illegal

parts.note: a deceiver is a liar

explanation.surface: Efforts to catch a fraudster following some illegal gambling.
explanation.walkthrough: L (end of 'illegal') and then LIAR make LLIAR, which goes inside BIDS after BI.
explanation.definitionFit: Billiards is a cue sport played on a cloth-covered table.

clue.text: First one goose, then another one, seen on a lake

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
a goose is a silly person, a nit
a second one, again the numeral I
L is the abbreviation for lake on maps

explanation.surface: A single goose followed by a second, swimming on a lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'goose' is not the bird but a fool, NIT, a common British word for an idiot.
explanation.definitionFit: Initial means first or at the beginning.

clue.text: Animal with hesitant expression settled in front of tunnel

indicators.note: settled in front of places the hesitant sound before the tunnel word

parts.note: er is the sound of someone hesitating
a mine is a tunnel dug underground

explanation.surface: A creature hesitating before settling at the mouth of a tunnel.
explanation.definitionFit: The ermine is a stoat, especially in its white winter coat.

clue.text: Spray on middle of abdomen slightly reduced wretched feeling

parts.note: on can mean at, as in on or at a given place

indicators.note: middle of takes the central letter of abdomen
slightly reduced means the word loses only its last letter

parts.note: misery is a wretched feeling

explanation.surface: A spray applied to the stomach lessens some discomfort.
explanation.walkthrough: The central letter of the seven-letter 'abdomen' is O; MISERY 'slightly reduced' drops its final Y to give MISER.
explanation.definitionFit: An atomiser is a device that turns a liquid into a fine spray.

clue.text: End of Dracula: evil repelled by leading characters in usual manner, producing garlic?

indicators.note: end of takes the final letter of Dracula
repelled means driven back, so the word for evil is read backwards

parts.note: ill means evil, as in ill will

indicators.note: leading characters are the first letters of the following words

explanation.surface: Count Dracula meets his end, with evil warded off in the traditional way, by garlic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'repelled' turns ILL into LLI. Garlic is the classic vampire repellent, so the surface tells the Dracula story.
explanation.definitionFit: Garlic is one species of the onion genus Allium, hence the question mark for definition by example.

clue.text: Disdain king's displayed, having turned round

indicators.note: round says the turned word goes round the letter for king

parts.note: to turn is to spin, past tense spun
R, for rex, is the abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: Contempt shown by a monarch who turned away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having turned round' reads as turning one's back, but SPUN goes round R.
explanation.definitionFit: To spurn is to reject with contempt, to disdain.

clue.text: Director of manoeuvres using discretion in imprisoning spies

parts.note: tact is discretion in dealing with others

indicators.note: imprisoning means the little word holds the spies inside it

parts.note: the CIA is the American spy agency

explanation.surface: A commander who handles imprisoned spies tactfully.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is not a link but letters: IN holds CIA to give ICIAN, after TACT.
explanation.definitionFit: A tactician plans and directs military moves or strategy.

clue.text: Vessel engaged in trade carrying quality shrub

indicators.note: carrying means the vessel holds the quality word inside it

parts.note: a coaster is a ship trading along the coast
tone is a quality, as of sound or colour

explanation.surface: A trading ship carrying a cargo of fine plants.
explanation.walkthrough: TONE goes into COASTER after CO.
explanation.definitionFit: Cotoneaster is a genus of hardy garden shrubs with red berries.

clue.text: Unusual power of countryside in which we see swallow, enthralling bird

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for power in physics

indicators.note: in which we see says the countryside word contains the next part

parts.note: rural means of the countryside

indicators.note: enthralling means holding captive, so the swallow word holds the bird

parts.note: to swallow is to eat
the tern is a seabird

explanation.surface: Strange happenings in the country: a swallow caught up with another bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swallow' looks like a bird beside 'bird', but it is the verb EAT. TERN inside EAT gives ETERNAT, which sits inside RURAL after R, all after P.
explanation.definitionFit: Preternatural means beyond the normal course of nature, extraordinary.

clue.text: Administrator, criticised severely, cursed

parts.note: exec is short for executive, an administrator
to rate someone is to scold or berate them

explanation.surface: A manager who came under heavy fire was sworn at.
explanation.definitionFit: To execrate is to curse or denounce with loathing.

clue.text: Vehicle, having to go round bend, did

indicators.note: the vehicle is made to go round the bend word, containing it

parts.note: a sled is a vehicle on runners
to wind is to bend or twist

explanation.surface: A sled had to steer round a corner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'did' is slang for cheated, as in 'we were done'; WIND goes inside SLED after S.
explanation.definitionFit: To do someone is slang for cheating or conning them.

clue.text: Exotic help where restricting insects is wanted?

definitions.text: Exotic help where restricting insects is wanted?

indicators.note: restricting means the anagram holds the insects within it
exotic means strange or foreign, signalling these letters take an unfamiliar new order

parts.note: ants are insects

explanation.surface: A call for some foreign assistance in keeping insects under control.
explanation.walkthrough: HELP WHERE rearranges to ELEPHHREW, and 'restricting' puts ANTS inside after ELEPH. The whole clue also defines it: an African animal that eats insects.
explanation.definitionFit: The elephant shrew is a long-snouted African mammal that feeds on insects such as ants and termites.

clue.text: Knight guarded by number going up and down wanting universal honour

indicators.note: guarded by means the knight's letter sits inside the number word
in a down clue going up means the number word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: one is a number
N is the chess notation for a knight

indicators.note: wanting means lacking, so the letter for universal is dropped

parts.note: down means sad, which is blue
U is the film certificate for universal viewing

explanation.surface: A knight honoured, with a number of ups and downs along the way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going up' turns ONE into ENO and N goes inside to make ENNO; 'down' is BLUE, and 'wanting universal' drops U to leave BLE.
explanation.definitionFit: To ennoble is to raise someone to the nobility, an honour.

clue.text: Poem, as presented by Auden, or in new layout?

indicators.note: a new layout signals the letters are set out in a different order

explanation.surface: Asking whether a poem is one by W. H. Auden or a rearrangement.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pretends Auden wrote it; the letters of AUDEN and OR are simply rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A rondeau is a short French verse form with a refrain.

clue.text: Trail entertainment, screening promotional item

indicators.note: screening means hiding behind, so the show contains the advert

parts.note: a show is an entertainment
an ad is a promotional advertisement

explanation.surface: A trailer for a show shown with an advert.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trail' looks like a film trailer but is the verb, to follow secretly; AD goes inside SHOW after SH.
explanation.definitionFit: To shadow someone is to follow or trail them closely.

clue.text: in a club, going around for voluntary payments

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held reads 'in a club, going around for voluntary payments (9)': it begins lower-case and is cut short, so the wordplay for HONORARIA is missing; no scan or reprint found.
annotationWithheld.clue: in a club, going around for voluntary payments

clue.text: Standard sound of guns

indicators.note: sound of says the word for guns is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: cannon are big guns, the plural the same as the singular

explanation.surface: A gunner's standard: the noise of the artillery.
explanation.definitionFit: A canon is a standard or rule by which things are judged.

clue.text: Low energy? Man must conserve it

indicators.note: to conserve is to keep, so the man word holds the energy letter inside

parts.note: a chap is a man
E is the symbol for energy in physics

explanation.surface: Low on energy? Then a man should save some.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Low energy' looks like one phrase, but 'Low' is the definition and 'it' refers back to E.
explanation.definitionFit: Low prices are cheap ones.

clue.text: Discussion that has newcomer to society worried

parts.note: a deb, or debutante, is a young woman entering high society
ate means worried, as in what's eating you

explanation.surface: Talk about a society newcomer who is anxious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worried' gives ATE through 'eat' meaning to trouble, as in 'what's eating you?'.
explanation.definitionFit: A debate is a formal discussion or argument.

clue.text: Unearthly alien seen by man — genuine?

parts.note: ET is the extraterrestrial of the film
he is the pronoun for a man
real means genuine

explanation.surface: Asking whether an alien spotted by a man was real.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethereal means heavenly or not of this world.

clue.text: Idly we messed about — not hard to manage

indicators.note: messed about means mucked around, signalling the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: We lazed around idly, finding it all easy.
explanation.definitionFit: Wieldy means easily handled, the rare positive of unwieldy.

clue.text: Support needed by revolutionary couple securing new advance

parts.note: a prop is a support

indicators.note: securing means holding firm, so the turned couple holds the new letter
revolutionary means turning over, so the word for couple is read backwards

parts.note: a duo is a couple

explanation.surface: A revolutionary pair needs backing to secure a fresh advance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' turns DUO into OUD, and N goes inside to give OUND.
explanation.definitionFit: To propound is to put forward an idea for consideration.
